info.title: Rr Cluster Admin Console API
info.description: Same-origin, read-only Console BFF API. All timestamps are RFC 3339 UTC. Missing or unsupported values are null or explicitly UNSUPPORTED, never zero. Explicit Admin seeds and trusted NodeDirectory/ConfigProvider records share one capability-aware projection; legacy AdminService UNIMPLEMENTED responses degrade only the affected feature.

201.description: Connection profile saved without starting a runtime

post.description: Tests a candidate without saving it or creating long-lived runtime tasks; existing_connection_id lets the BFF resolve Keep secrets without returning them

200.description: Connection runtime is active or connecting
Connection-scoped node and local Raft observations

parameters.name: node_id
parameters.description: Seed used for on-demand detail collection

post.description: Runs or joins the connection's shared collection flight. Requires same-origin Origin and, when viewer authentication is enabled, X-Console-CSRF.

get.description: Server-sent summary events for only this connection

200.description: Cluster summary, possibly partial or stale
Node-owned boot records with an opaque upstream history cursor and persistence mode; legacy nodes return an empty page plus UNSUPPORTED boot_history

parameters.name: node_id
parameters.description: Seed used for on-demand detail collection

200.description: On-demand legacy and full replica evidence. Flat matched/lag/heartbeat fields are projected only from leader evidence and retain leader_replication; local and cluster commit indexes remain distinct; deprecated snapshot_in_progress is not returned

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Select bounded live retention or fixed-template Prometheus history

200.description: Reset-safe live rates and aggregate histogram quantiles, or fixed-template Prometheus history. UNMAPPED and UNSUPPORTED are explicit; server/proposal/apply cohorts are never subtracted
Snapshot indexes plus reset-safe install and transfer rates when trusted metrics are available; node-only build failures never become group facts
Current build/boot state, restart history, or version history using bounded cached node boot-journal pages; unsupported nodes are identified by capability
Explicit-seed or trusted-discovery source health, directory revisions, identity quarantine, capabilities and retention

post.description: Runs or joins the single shared collection flight. Requires a same-origin Origin header and, when viewer authentication is enabled, X-Console-CSRF.

get.description: Server-sent summary events. A resync event asks the client to perform a full GET after lag.

200.description: CSRF token and expiry for the current viewer session; does not create or rotate a session

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: Exact same-origin Console origin; required for every protected mutation

CsrfToken.name: X-Console-CSRF
CsrfToken.description: Required when viewer authentication is enabled

BadRequest.description: Invalid argument with runtime metadata when a runtime was resolved

LegacyBadRequest.description: Legacy invalid argument with runtime metadata, or CONNECTION_REQUIRED with neutral metadata

ControlBadRequest.description: Invalid connection or control-plane input with neutral metadata

ControlUnprocessableEntity.description: JSON body is syntactically valid but does not match the control DTO; neutral metadata

ControlPayloadTooLarge.description: JSON body exceeds the Console limit; neutral metadata

Unauthenticated.description: Missing, expired or invalid viewer session

NotFound.description: Resource or API route not found with uniform metadata

ResourceOrConnectionNotFound.description: Resource NOT_FOUND with runtime metadata, or CONNECTION_NOT_FOUND with neutral metadata

UpstreamError.description: Upstream collection failed with sanitized error and uniform metadata

HandlerDeadline.description: On-demand collection exceeded the overall 2s handler deadline; error code HANDLER_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED

ConnectionNotFound.description: Unknown connection ID; error code CONNECTION_NOT_FOUND

ConnectionNotConnected.description: The connection has no active runtime; error code CONNECTION_NOT_CONNECTED

ConnectionActive.description: The operation requires a disconnected connection; error code CONNECTION_ACTIVE

ConnectionRequired.description: Legacy route has no fixed ephemeral startup connection; error code CONNECTION_REQUIRED

CredentialsRequired.description: Required session credentials must be supplied again; error code CREDENTIALS_REQUIRED

ActiveConnectionLimit.description: The active connection limit was reached; error code ACTIVE_CONNECTION_LIMIT

ConnectionTestFailed.description: The candidate or saved connection test failed; error code CONNECTION_TEST_FAILED

ConnectionInitializationFailed.description: The connection runtime could not be initialized; error code CONNECTION_INITIALIZATION_FAILED

ConnectionStoreFailed.description: Connection profile or secret state failed; error code CONNECTION_STORE_FAILED

ConnectionShuttingDown.description: The connection manager is shutting down; error code CONNECTION_SHUTTING_DOWN

cert.description: Console-host client certificate path; must be paired with key

key.description: Console-host private-key path; key contents are never accepted or returned

url.description: Absolute HTTP(S) base URL without userinfo, query or fragment

observed_cluster_id.description: Trusted runtime formation identity, asynchronously backfilled once without list-driven writes

ConnectionStatus.description: CONNECTING has no observable runtime yet. CONNECTED, DEGRADED (partial/stale cache), and UNREACHABLE (all seeds failed) retain the valid runtime and scoped API/SSE; recovery can return to CONNECTED. DISCONNECTED has no runtime.

credentials_configured.description: Whether this process can currently obtain all required secrets

ConnectionSecrets.description: Write-only secret inputs. Omitted keeps the current value, null clears it, and a non-empty string replaces it.

remember.description: Persist supplied secrets in the OS keychain instead of process memory

existing_connection_id.description: Existing profile whose secrets are resolved inside the BFF only when the corresponding secret input is Keep

allOf.description: At least one of admin_seeds or discovery is required
Connection-independent metadata for control-plane and authentication responses

compatibility.description: Current boots use current same-group peer evidence; historical boots are UNKNOWN

labels.description: Complete scope/kind/mount label set; label variants are never overwritten

rate.description: True for reset-safe per-second counter rates, false for raw samples

metrics.description: Legacy metric-name projection retained for compatibility; samples is the lossless evidence list

filesystems.description: All observed mounts; flat filesystem fields select root when available, otherwise the first mount

ready.description: Latest cached readiness probe value; null when no probe evidence is available

liveness.description: Latest cached health probe value; null when no probe evidence is available

ready_phase.description: Node-reported readiness phase, retained even when ready is false

resources.description: Flat UI values plus lossless labeled resource evidence; null when unavailable

leader_node_id.description: Legacy leader_node_id=0 is normalized to null

voters_reachable.description: Fresh reachable members of expected_replica_node_ids, not a Raft quorum proof

commit_index.description: Local commit index for the UI; local_commit_index remains as an explicit alias

matched_index.description: Leader-observed matched index; null when no leader supplied evidence

lag_entries.description: Leader-observed lag; null is never normalized to zero

source_node_id.description: Leader source for matched/lag/heartbeat evidence, otherwise the local source

local_observed_at.description: Local sample time retained when observed_at is aligned to leader evidence

observed_at.description: Observation time for source_node_id; local_observed_at retains a local sample time when leader evidence is joined

install_count.description: Current raw install counter; never inferred from snapshot indexes

install_rate.description: Reset-safe installs per second after the first scrape

next_cursor.description: Opaque Console or node boot-journal cursor; clients must not parse it
